description: This file contains API declarations for ASN.1 PrivateKeyInfo objects and related cryptographic structures. It provides function prototypes to create ASN.1 representations of various private key types and associated objects, commonly used in cryptographic implementations.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateEncryptedPrivateKeyInfo
methods.description: Creates an ASN.1 EncryptedPrivateKeyInfo structure, representing encrypted private key data.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateEncryptionAlgorithmIdentifier
methods.description: Creates an ASN.1 AlgorithmIdentifier for the encryption algorithm used in encrypted private key info.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreatePrivateKeyInfo
methods.description: Creates an ASN.1 PrivateKeyInfo structure containing version, algorithm, and key data.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreatePrivateKeyInfoWithKey
methods.description: Creates an ASN.1 PrivateKeyInfo with specified key type and parameters.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreatePrivateKey
methods.description: Creates an ASN.1 PrivateKey choice structure (RSA or DSA private key).

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateRSAPrivateKey
methods.description: Creates an ASN.1 RSA private key structure.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateDSAPrivateKey
methods.description: Creates an ASN.1 DSA private key structure.
